statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41888 affects the distribution registry's authorization middleware, which evaluates repository-scoped access tokens during push/pull operations on the registry HTTP API. harbor-exporter is a Prometheus metrics exporter; it does not run the distribution registry or its HTTP API server. It links the distribution/v2 library only as a client for parsing image references and manifest metadata when collecting artifact metrics, so the vulnerable authorization middleware code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-35172 affects the distribution registry blob storage layer when storage.cache.blobdescriptor uses redis and storage.delete.enabled is true, allowing revoked repo-local blob descriptor reads to return after peer-repo activity. harbor-exporter is a Prometheus metrics exporter; it does not run the distribution registry or its redis-backed blob storage backend. The bundled Harbor registry component is a separate image (goharbor/registry). harbor-exporter links distribution/v2 only as a client for parsing image references and manifest metadata, so the vulnerable storage code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-33540 affects the distribution registry pull-through cache proxy authentication flow, where credentials can be sent to an attacker-controlled realm URL when an operator configures an upstream registry. harbor-exporter is a Prometheus metrics exporter; it does not run the distribution pull-through cache proxy or any distribution registry server. It links the distribution/v2 library only as a client for parsing image references and manifest metadata when collecting artifact metrics, so the vulnerable server-side proxy code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-41888 affects the distribution registry HTTP handler layer (registry/handlers/manifests.go and registry/storage/tagstore.go), where DeleteManifest can untag a manifest even when storage.delete.enabled is false. Harbor registryctl does not import registry/handlers and does not instantiate tagService; its manifest endpoint parses the reference as a digest and rejects tag references, deleting via storage.NewVacuum.RemoveManifest directly on the storage driver, so the vulnerable handler code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-35172 affects the distribution registry blob storage layer when storage.cache.blobdescriptor uses redis and storage.delete.enabled is true, allowing revoked repo-local blob descriptor reads to return after peer-repo activity. Harbor registryctl does not run a distribution registry or its redis-backed blob descriptor cache. It uses storage.NewVacuum directly against a raw storage driver to remove blobs, bypassing the cachedBlobStatter and repositoryScopedRedisBlobDescriptorService entirely, so the vulnerable storage code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-33540 affects the distribution registry pull-through cache proxy authentication flow (registry/proxy and internal/client/auth), where credentials can be sent to an attacker-controlled realm URL when an operator configures an upstream registry. Harbor registryctl does not run a distribution registry or its pull-through cache proxy. It links the distribution library only via registry/storage to perform local Vacuum garbage-collection operations on a mounted storage driver, so the vulnerable server-side proxy code path is never executed.
